name: ryu.ego-browser
description: Ego lite (https://github.com/citrolabs/ego-lite) as an optional provider for Ryu's swappable browser.control layer. Immutable operation tools launch the installed ego-browser CLI in a conversation-scoped Ego Space while small adapters preserve the stable browser.* verbs. Tabs, snapshot and screenshot carry read-only effect metadata; navigation, click, type, scroll and the legacy mixed dispatcher are conservatively mutating. Caller input cannot change an operation tool into another action. Requires the Ego lite macOS app and ego-browser on PATH; Ryu does not install Ego lite or copy browser login state.
